money.noTotalNote: The rows above stay in their own currency: a cruise stores a price and a currency, and simply adding amounts in different currencies would produce a figure nobody ever paid. The total below brings everything into the base currency instead — amounts already in it unchanged, all others at the recorded rate — and names what it had to leave out.

tracks.title: Recorded tracks
tracks.intro: A GPS recording replaces a leg's computed sea route when it reaches both ports in sailing order (within 10 km, e.g. at anchor) and at most a quarter of the way is missing. Missing stretches are bridged with a straight line and counted.
